places.name: Ogallala
places.note: Boys wander the long street; scout Dixon clubs Dish and quirts Newt, and Call nearly beats him to death by a blacksmith's anvil.

places.note: Hungover hands straggle back; Po Campo grudgingly lends the wagon and predicts a dry stretch ahead.
